name: nimbus-crm
description: Nexora CRM: React + TypeScript frontend, Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL backend.

scripts.setup: npm install && node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run db:deploy
scripts.db:deploy: node scripts/with-db.mjs npm run db:deploy -w server
scripts.dev:app: npm run db:deploy -w server && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/with-db.mjs npm run db:migrate -w server
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/with-db.mjs npm run db:reset -w server
scripts.seed: node scripts/with-db.mjs npm run seed -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
